parts.title: Learning from a comparison
questions: Do you like trying two different ways to do the same task?
When do you usually ask someone to show you another method?
Do you write notes when you are learning something new?
What makes a useful example in a lesson?

parts.title: Individual talk
parts.cue: Describe a time when comparing two methods helped you learn something.
questions: Say what you were trying to do.
Explain what you noticed when you compared them.
Say what you would recommend to someone trying the task for the first time.

parts.title: Discussion
questions: Why can the same teaching method work differently for different students?
How can a classroom trial help a teacher decide what to change?
What information can an average result hide?
When is it useful to keep a method that does not give the highest test score?
